notes.title: What's New: Support Japanese!
notes.content:
Update Log
New Content:
1. Support [b]Japanese[/b] now! We hope Japanese users can have more enjoyment of SpaceTone.

Optimizations and bug fixes:
1. Support borderless window
2. Corrected some errors in English  
3. Fixed a bug, which could lead to a game crash as tapping the quit button(Q) at fisrt entering.

Future Updates:
1. Four Button Mode---less button, easier to operate
2. Users will be able to create and edit new levels by themselves (STEAM Workshop)
3. Enhence some low-resolution images
